scope: Compare only the monitored original core/vendor trees, named anchors, and original recommendation module scaffold. No production runtime, database, service, model or credentials accessed.
tree_digest_algorithm: For sorted relative POSIX file paths inside each tree: SHA256 of concatenated relative_path + NUL + file_sha256_hex + LF (UTF-8). File content hashed with SHA256; symlinks, .local directories and .env/.env.* are excluded.

independent_review.method: Read-only source review plus narrow inline PHP synthetic reproductions using backend/.runtime/php-mysql/bin/php -n and test-only autoload. No source/test files created by reviewer; full suites are owned and run by implementation agents.

confirmed_findings.issue: A lower configured limits.recall was not enforced before candidate projection reads.
confirmed_findings.resolution: recallRanks now validates the configured bound and rejects disabled routes before reading projections.
confirmed_findings.verification: Independent static reread confirms placement; formal recall=10/11 rejection test is reported separately by the parent agent.

confirmed_findings.issue: Equal dimension/operator-family/wanted values merged independent feature sources, allowing a soft work_style match to satisfy an unknown hard preferences requirement.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Deduplication key includes candidate feature sources and normalized aliases. Each original hard rule is checked against its independent known/score result.
confirmed_findings.verification: Same inline synthetic reproduction rerun after fix; no real profile data or database.

confirmed_findings.issue: Management permission revoked during publish catalog read was not rechecked before moving the active policy pointer.
confirmed_findings.resolution: Write operations revalidate management access immediately before save/publish after dependent reads; create also checks inside the transaction.
confirmed_findings.verification: Same inline catalog wrapper revocation reproduction rerun after fix.

other_reviewed_boundaries: Semantic-to-dimension declarations cannot cross scoring dimensions; personality/preference aliases cannot invent equivalences.
Mapping uses explicit catalog binding and minimal already-authorized snapshots; unknown/new fields do not automatically enter matching.
Schema/type/enum/scope/cardinality changes invalidate affected bindings. Labels alone do not alter semantic fingerprints.
Policy publication requires current validation and actual replay, revision/content/catalog/suite checks, and active-pointer CAS; rollback repeats these gates.
Fixed-anchor near-score bands avoid transitive widening; at most one lower-exposure exploration entry; scores are not changed by selection.
Exposure history is per requesting viewer and Space; fresh candidate/relationship reads follow history access; ordinary discovery does not inherit AI-only relationship-history exclusions.
Synthetic rule failures remain dependency/validation errors; lack of qualified evidence returns real insufficiency, not cross-Space filler.

limitations: R2 is a pure in-memory rule/configuration implementation; real P1 batch authorization, current Space selection, persistent policy storage and public API adapters remain later-stage work.

Binding semantic is a trusted administrative declaration, not proof of source semantics. R3 needs an independent discovery-purpose/source authority; source-name defenses alone do not grant permission.
Formal storage/adapters must keep management permission and catalog epoch protection through commit; final snapshot checks alone do not close external races.
This report does not claim production recommendation quality, database integration, module enablement or a live AI path.
No entire P1/other-plugin or recommendation-document tree comparison was made. Only explicitly monitored paths are claimed unchanged; other agents may still edit authorized recommendation documents.
R2 vendor digest excludes one .env path and symlinks by design; do not compare directly to R1 vendor digest/count created under a different exclusion rule.
The independent reviewer did not rerun full implementation test suites; parent test evidence is separate.
